title: UFO targets in the remote viewing unit came as practice sessions or favors for generals

tellings.quote: all of the rest of the times that we did a lot of UFO stuff [sighs and gasps] uh came under the heading of practice sessions

plain: In the 1980s, an Army remote viewing unit, which trained soldiers to describe faraway targets by mind alone, did "a lot of UFO stuff," but always off the books, logged as "practice sessions" or done as favors for generals. Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who served in the unit, tells Michels this himself.
